devops.headline: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
devops.credentials: a Computer Science graduate of KNUST and a Cloud Engineer who designs and automates AWS infrastructure
devops.closing_skills: cloud engineering skills, automation focus, and adaptability
highlights: Building a self-healing AWS system for a Flask microservice using Lambda, CloudWatch, and Amazon Bedrock that detects anomalies and generates AI-driven root-cause reports without manual intervention.
Provisioning 55 AWS resources through modular Terraform (VPC, EC2, Lambda, EventBridge, SNS) with tfsec security scanning and GitHub Actions CI for fully reproducible infrastructure.
Cutting infrastructure cost 60% through automated instance scheduling, delivered via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines with full observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Jaeger).
Engineering a secure software supply chain and disaster recovery lab with immutable artifacts and cross-region RDS failover, achieving a recovery time objective of 30 minutes or less.

Designing secure VPCs, subnets, and IAM roles across 10+ AWS services (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudFormation) that cut potential security misconfigurations by 30%, applying Cisco networking fundamentals and day-to-day Linux and Bash administration.
devops.followup_expertise: Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, cloud cost optimisation, and network and security hardening

software.headline: Full-Stack JavaScript Engineer
software.credentials: a Computer Science graduate of KNUST and a full-stack JavaScript engineer who has shipped React and Node.js applications to production for paying clients
software.closing_skills: full-stack delivery, product focus, and ability to run what I build
highlights: Building, as sole engineer, a live data-bundle reseller platform: a React + TypeScript storefront with agent and admin dashboards, and a NestJS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL API with Paystack payments, customer wallets, and four-tier margin splits stored as integer pesewas.
Adding reliability tooling for real money in flight on that platform: background sweeps that recover lost payment webhooks, stuck-order alerts, refunds, withdrawals, and float-risk reporting.

Building authentication, real-time chat (Socket.IO), the news feed, and notifications for Diaspora Connect, a live Next.js social platform working against a GraphQL API, and cutting search request volume by about half.
Reducing page load time by about 40% through code splitting and lazy loading in a React pharmacy management system, with Redux Toolkit state and Cypress end-to-end tests.
Deploying and running what I build, with Docker, CI/CD, and Terraform on AWS ECS Fargate from my work as a Cloud Engineer at AmaliTech.
software.followup_expertise: React, Node.js and NestJS, payments integration, and shipping production features end to end

letter.intro: I am writing to express my strong interest in the {role} position at {company}. I am a full-stack JavaScript engineer with about three years of React and two and a half years of Node.js, and I have shipped React and Node.js applications to production for paying clients. My cloud background means I can also deploy and run what I build.
letter.lead_in: Recent work that speaks to the role:

bullets.title: Payments & Production Systems
bullets.text: As sole engineer on a live data-bundle reseller platform, I designed, built, and deployed a React + TypeScript storefront and dashboards and a NestJS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL API integrating Paystack, with customer wallets, four-tier margin splits stored as integer pesewas, and background sweeps that recover lost payment webhooks.

bullets.title: Frontend Engineering
bullets.text: On Diaspora Connect, a live Next.js social platform, I was one of two main frontend contributors: I built authentication end to end, real-time chat with Socket.IO, the news feed, and notifications against a GraphQL API, and cut search request volume by about half.

bullets.title: Shipping End to End
bullets.text: I built a booking platform with a React 18 site, a NestJS API with role-based permissions on Supabase and PostgreSQL, and a catalogue-grounded AI assistant using the Anthropic Claude SDK, deployed with Terraform to AWS ECS Fargate.

letter.closing: Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my full-stack delivery, product focus, and ability to run what I build can support the engineering team at {company}.
